prompts.role: Six-area entry corridor and actual room thresholds
prompts.prompt: Create one 16:9 landscape full-room background painting for Sinefine's fixed-camera 2.5D game, no UI and no people. This is Kiritsugu, Irisviel and Illya's modest family new home in Fuyuki: PROJECT ADAPTATION, not the German Einzbern castle nor Emiya's traditional Japanese house. Reference 1 is the existing approved family lounge: preserve pale plaster, mellow oak, cream textiles, small European mementos and a garden with gardenias. Reference 2 establishes the user's approved soft blended anime background style: selective soft edges, restrained warm highlights, cool grey ambient fill, matte material transitions and simple foliage masses. Keep navigation thresholds crisp enough to see; no global blur, no haze filter, no crispy black outlines, no high-contrast orange sunshine, no glossy render. Slightly elevated fixed front three-quarter camera, grounded modest proportions, straight stable perspective, horizon around 35 percent. Full canvas is one room, broad readable oak floor across the foreground and centre; all furniture supported on the floor, nothing huge clipping foreground. No readable writing, labels, watermark or floor arrows. Keep open walking space from centre bottom to every doorway. Paint the entrance hall, a wide cosy single-floor family corridor with five separate clear door openings leading to different rooms. Left near opening to lounge at about x18%, floor threshold y66%; left rear opening to kitchen at x32%, threshold y46%; centre back open study doorway x53%, threshold y43%; right rear bedroom door x73%, threshold y47%; right near daughter's room door x89%, threshold y64%. Modest cream doors and warm wood frames, not tall grand castle arches. Near bottom centre is the entrance from street, out of camera behind viewer; keep x50% bottom clear for exit. A low closed shoe cabinet only at far lower left side, a compact umbrella/coat stand far lower right, a pair of adult shoes and small purple boots tucked alongside cabinet, not obstructing paths; small vase of gardenias, one family photograph, simple runner in corridor without busy pattern. Doorways and floor boundaries clearly visible. Room feels lived-in, gentle and calm.

prompts.role: Four-direction stand and registered six-phase side gait
prompts.prompt: Generate a production native transparent RGBA sprite atlas for a fixed-camera 2.5D anime game. Soft hand-painted anime/chibi blend, roughly 4.5 heads tall adults, consistent clothes and face, rounded soft edges but crisp eyes and soles; diffuse cool ambient fill with restrained warm highlights; no floor, no drawn shadows, no background, no gridlines, no cell captions, no weapons or magic. Fully complete bodies including every hair strand and both feet, blank alpha gutters around each figure, do not crop. Six exactly evenly spaced columns and three rows, eighteen cells; do not draw extra people outside cells. Row 1: four quiet standing directions in first four cells (front, back, LEFT profile, RIGHT profile), last two cells completely transparent. Row 2: LEFT-facing side-view six distinct walking phases in order: left foot planted ahead/right heel up, right swing passing left knee, feet under hips with left heel rising, right foot planted ahead/left heel up, left swing passing right knee, opposite feet under hips with right heel rising. Obvious alternating bent knees and independent foot separation; actual foot contact, not six copies of a wide stance. Opposite arms swing. All six side frames same body scale, feet same ground baseline, head height stable with small natural bob. Row 3 first three cells FRONT walk (left contact, passing, right contact); last three BACK walk (left contact, passing, right contact). Keep equal body proportions across rows and generous clear vertical row gutters. Only row 2 will be mirrored for rightward walking. Reference 1 is identity ONLY: Kiritsugu Emiya, adult man with messy short black hair, brown/dark eyes, quiet tired expression, small soft face; remove all action scene elements and weapon. House outfit follows his original black silhouette: simple charcoal hip-length jacket over dark shirt, straight black trousers, matte dark shoes. No huge windblown trench coat, no gloves, no cigarette. Reference 2 is soft light and painterly material treatment ONLY, never add street as background. Calm everyday walk, no running or combat. Keep dark outfit readable through cool-grey reflected light, avoid pure black cutout. Black messy hair and restrained expression consistent in all sixteen occupied cells.
